fetch_warnings: count_5394_vs_wco_5387: HMRC base includes 7 codes more than the pure WCO HS 2022 list (5387). HMRC tracks all WCO 6-digits and may carry a small number of UK/EU-specific 6-digit splits at heading boundaries. All 5394 entries here are valid 6-digit codes present in HMRC trade tariff.

cross_check_passed_5_of_5: Spot-checked 0901.21, 2710.12, 3004.90, 7308.30, 8703.23 against foreign-trade.com (WCO HS lookup). All 5 codes match semantically; HMRC descriptions use the WCO subheading text with parent context joined by -- separator.

description_format: Descriptions follow WCO indented structure -- when a 6-digit code has a parent subheading header (suffix=10 in HMRC), the parent and child descriptions are concatenated with " -- " to give full context. Example: 0901.21 = "Coffee, roasted -- Not decaffeinated".

html_cleaned: 77 codes containing HTML markup (sup/sub tags) were normalized to Unicode superscripts/subscripts for chemistry notation like cubic centimeters, vitamin B subscripts, and phosphorus pentoxide.
